title: From Empirical Evaluation to Context-Aware Enhancement: Repairing Regression Errors with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2506.13182v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: [...] Since then, various APR approaches, especially those leveraging the power of large language models (LLMs), have been rapidly developed to fix general software bugs. Unfortunately, the effectiveness of these advanced techniques in the context of regression bugs remains largely unexplored. This gap motivates the need for an empirical study evaluating the effectiveness of modern APR techniques in fixing real-world regression bugs.   In this work, we conduct an empirical study of APR techniques on regression bugs. To facilitate our study, we introduce RegressionBug4APR, a high-quality benchmark of Java and Python regression bugs integrated into a framework designed to facilitate APR research. The current benchmark includes 200 regression bugs collected from widely used real-world GitHub repositories. translated_title: 从经验评估到情境感知增强：利用大语言模型修复回归错误
translated_abstract: arXiv:2506.13182v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：[...] 自那时起，各种自动程序修复（APR）方法，尤其是那些利用大语言模型（LLMs）能力的方法，已被迅速发展用于修复一般软件缺陷。然而，这些先进技术在回归错误情境下的有效性在很大程度上仍未得到探索。这一差距促使我们需要进行一项实证研究，评估现代APR技术在修复现实世界回归错误方面的有效性。在本工作中，我们对回归错误上的APR技术进行了实证研究。为促进我们的研究，我们引入了RegressionBug4APR，一个高质量的Java和Python回归错误基准，集成到一个旨在促进APR研究的框架中。当前基准包含从广泛使用的现实世界GitHub仓库中收集的200个回归错误。我们首先对基准进行了深入分析，展示其多样性和质量。在此基础上，我们进一步探索了情境感知增强方法，以提升LLM在修复回归错误时的表现。
tldr: 本文提出了一个包含200个真实世界Java和Python回归错误的高质量基准RegressionBug4APR，并通过实证研究评估了现代APR技术，进而探索了情境感知增强策略以提升LLM修复回归错误的效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RegressionBug4APR, a high-quality benchmark of 200 real-world Java and Python regression bugs, and empirically evaluates modern APR techniques while exploring context-aware enhancement strategies to improve LLM-based regression bug repair.
